content.value_statement: Upcoming events can be difficult to review across multiple calendars. This skill displays a read-only agenda with date, calendar, and timezone filters.
actual_capabilities: Shows upcoming events across all connected Google calendars.
Filters events for today, tomorrow, the current week, or a selected number of days.
Filters the agenda by a calendar name or identifier.
Displays dates using the Google account timezone or a specified IANA timezone.
Supports table output through the gws command format option.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and an authenticated Google account.
Only reads agenda data and does not create, edit, or delete events.
Calendar access remains limited by the authenticated account permissions.
The skill does not document free-text event search or attendee filtering.

use_cases.title: Review Daily Meetings
use_cases.description: Display today's events across every connected calendar before starting work.

use_cases.title: Plan the Work Week
use_cases.description: Review this week's schedule to identify conflicts and available time.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Across Timezones
use_cases.description: View upcoming events in a selected IANA timezone when coordinating distributed teams.

prompt_templates.title: Show My Agenda
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my upcoming Google Calendar events across all calendars.

prompt_templates.title: Review Today
prompt_templates.prompt: Show today's events across all calendars using my Google account timezone.

prompt_templates.title: Filter a Work Calendar
prompt_templates.prompt: Show events from my Work calendar for the next three days.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Timezone Agenda
prompt_templates.prompt: Show this week's events in America/New_York and format the results as a table.

best_practices: Use a specific date range to keep the agenda concise.
Select a calendar when only one schedule is relevant.
Specify an IANA timezone when reviewing events for another region.
anti_patterns: Do not expect the skill to modify or cancel calendar events.
Do not request calendars unavailable to the authenticated Google account.
Do not use ambiguous timezone abbreviations when an IANA timezone is available.

faq.question: Does this skill change calendar events?
faq.answer: No. It only reads and displays upcoming events.

faq.question: Can it show events from every calendar?
faq.answer: Yes. It queries all accessible calendars unless you select one calendar.

faq.question: Can I view only today's events?
faq.answer: Yes. Request today's agenda to limit results to the current day.

faq.question: Can I choose another timezone?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide an IANA timezone such as America/New_York.

faq.question: What authentication is required?
faq.answer: The gws CLI must be authenticated with a Google account that can access the requested calendars.

faq.question: Can I filter by calendar?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the calendar name or identifier.
